body_markdown:
Join eFax® in Las Vegas for HLTH 2026, the global epicenter for healthcare innovation and digital health transformation. As health systems and tech leaders gather to reshape care delivery, eFax® will be onsite showcasing our enhanced inbound document processing and workflow platform.


Visit us at Booth #4021 to learn more about eFax® Harmony. Through its smart extraction, workflow management, and deep EHR/RIS integration, eFax® Harmony decreases referral leakage, reduces intake time, increases staff productivity, and helps to reduce the manual burden of prior authorizations and referrals.
